reason: The image shows a genuine greenhouse structure under active construction with GI-pipe arched framework and partial polyfilm covering, which correctly represents the MCAT's core service.

However, the setting appears to be a Western/temperate farm context (dense green trees, red ladder, lawn tractor) rather than an Indian agricultural field, and the partially constructed state with construction equipment clutters the frame — a completed Indian NVPH polyhouse with visible UV-film covering and crop rows inside would be a significantly stronger, buyer-relevant thumbnail.

mcat_image_suggestions.prompt_for_generation: Photorealistic aerial-perspective view of a completed multi-span naturally ventilated polyhouse (NVPH) on a flat Indian agricultural field under bright daylight. The structure has a white UV-stabilized polyethylene film covering stretched over galvanized iron pipe arches, with open roll-up side vents and ridge ventilation. Inside, rows of green vegetable plants (capsicum or cucumber) are visible through the transparent film. The foreground shows bare red-brown Indian soil. Clear blue sky background. Clean, professional composition with no people, no ladders, no construction clutter. Sharp focus, high contrast, commercial product-style lighting.
